description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hindagala, Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320293 (23/1045)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and ownership details (both state-owned and private individuals). The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
